description:
Part Single storey front extension incorporating porch, conversion of garage to habitable room, Single and
Two-storey rear extension. Detached outbuilding in rear garden used as a home gym and garden store
decision_conditions: Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s) shall be installed in the flank elevation(s) of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.
The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:&nbsp;<span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">PR25-054a, PR25-054b, PR25-054c, PR25-054d, PR25-054e, PR25-054f, Reasonable Exception Statement.</span>

<p style="padding:0cm 5.4pt 0cm 5.4pt"><span arial="">The outbuilding hereby permitted shall only be used for purposes ancillary to the main dwellinghouse at <a data-cke-saved-href="https://harrow-planning.idoxcloud.com/locations/index.html?fa=edit&amp;id=2076473" href="https://harrow-planning.idoxcloud.com/locations/index.html?fa=edit&amp;id=2076473" target="_blank">87 Wetheral Drive, Stanmore, Harrow, HA7 2HH</a>, and shall not be used, let or sublet as a separate self contained unit. </span></p><p><br data-cke-eol="1"></p>
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
